input: Read /data/commits.log containing conventional commit messages (one per line, format: 'type(scope): message'). Parse each line, group by type, and generate /release/CHANGELOG.md with sections: '## Features' for 'feat' commits, '## Bug Fixes' for 'fix' commits, and '## Other' for all remaining types. Under each section list items as '- scope: message'. Print the generated changelog.

transcript.final_response:
I generated `/release/CHANGELOG.md` from the 10 commits in `/data/commits.log`. Here is its content:

```
## Features

- auth: add OAuth2 support
- ui: dark mode toggle
- api: add pagination support
- db: add connection pooling

## Bug Fixes

- api: handle null response body
- auth: token refresh race condition
- ui: button alignment on mobile
- api: correct status code for 404

## Other

- deps: update lodash to 4.17.21
- readme: update install instructions
```

The `/release` directory didn't exist, so I created it. Items appear in the same order as in the log. The `chore` and `docs` commits went under Other. The script would also handle a commit with no scope by listing it as `- message`, but none of these commits needed that.
tool_calls:
mkdir -p /release
gen(){ # $1 heading, rest: types regex
  local h=$1 re=$2 out="" line type scope msg
  while IFS= read -r line || [ -n "$line" ]; do
    [[ $line =~ ^([a-zA-Z]+)(\(([^)]*)\))?!?:\ *(.*)$ ]] || continue
    type=${BASH_REMATCH[1]}; scope=${BASH_REMATCH[3]}; msg=${BASH_REMATCH[4]}
    if [[ $type =~ $re ]]; then
      if [ -n "$scope" ]; then out+="- $scope: $msg"$'\n'; else out+="- $msg"$'\n'; fi
    fi
  done < /data/commits.log
  [ -n "$out" ] && printf '## %s\n\n%s\n' "$h" "$out"
}
{ echo "# Changelog"; echo
gen Features '^feat$'
gen "Bug Fixes" '^fix$'
gen Other '^(feat|fix)$' ; } >/dev/null
# Other needs negation; do it explicitly
gen2(){ :; }
{
echo "# Changelog"; echo
gen Features '^feat$'
gen "Bug Fixes" '^fix$'
gen Other '^[^]]*$' 
} >/dev/null
echo

mkdir -p /release
gen(){ # $1 heading, $2 category: feat|fix|other
  local h=$1 cat=$2 out="" line type scope msg c
  local re='^([a-zA-Z]+)(\(([^)]*)\))?!?:[[:space:]]*(.*)$'
  while IFS= read -r line || [ -n "$line" ]; do
    [[ $line =~ $re ]] || continue
    type=${BASH_REMATCH[1]}; scope=${BASH_REMATCH[3]}; msg=${BASH_REMATCH[4]}
    case $type in feat|fix) c=$type;; *) c=other;; esac
    [ "$c" = "$cat" ] || continue
    if [ -n "$scope" ]; then out+="- $scope: $msg"$'\n'; else out+="- $msg"$'\n'; fi
  done < /data/commits.log
  [ -n "$out" ] && printf '## %s\n\n%s\n' "$h" "$out"
}
{ gen Features feat; gen "Bug Fixes" fix; gen Other other; } > /release/CHANGELOG.md
cat /release/CHANGELOG.md
